title: Tester acceptance probability
statement: Let $D$ be a domain, let a finite predicate template specify a Boolean satisfaction rule for each predicate, and let a uniform string tester have a finite nonempty seed space. For an assignment of values in $D$ to every declared variable, its acceptance is the probability, over a uniformly chosen seed, that the selected predicate is satisfied by the assignment restricted to the ordered variables queried by that seed.
hypotheses_covered: A predicate template over $D$ with finitely many predicates and Boolean evaluation rules
A value assignment from the declared variables to $D
